title: ASC 450 Loss Contingencies Register
description: Extension schema for the vwp-accounting-asc450 extension: the register at facts/contingencies.json. One entry per loss contingency as of the assessment date with the likelihood and estimability concluded (ASC 450-20-25-2), the estimate range, the amount accrued (ASC 450-20-30-1: the best estimate, else the low end of the range), whether disclosure is required (ASC 450-20-50), and the judgment that concluded. The validators check that every item links a resolvable judgment, that the accrual follows from the likelihood and the range, that disclosure follows from the likelihood, and that the executable accrual schedule books exactly the accrued items.

likelihood.description: ASC 450-20-20 likelihood of the future event confirming the loss.

estimable.description: Whether the loss is reasonably estimable (ASC 450-20-25-2(b)).

bestEstimate.description: The best estimate within the range when one amount is a better estimate than any other (ASC 450-20-30-1).

estimateFact.description: Fact id whose value is {low, high[, best]} for the range; checked against estimateLow/estimateHigh/bestEstimate when present.

accrued.description: Amount accrued as of asOf: the best estimate, else the low end of the range, for probable and estimable losses; zero otherwise.

evidenceRef.description: Evidence or fact id (legal letter, notice, claim) supporting the item.
